subject.title: feat(ui): Labs settings page for experimental feature toggles

question: Should Settings → Labs become the maintained Control UI surface for persistent user-controlled experimental feature toggles, beginning with Code Mode?
rationale: This is more than a route addition: it establishes a discoverable settings category and registry pattern that future experimental capabilities will follow.

options.title: Sponsor Labs with live toggle proof
options.body: Accept Labs as the experimental-settings seam, contingent on redacted evidence that both Code Mode transitions persist safely through the live Control UI and Gateway.

options.title: Keep experimental controls config-only
options.body: Defer the new Labs navigation and registry until maintainers define the long-term governance and scope for experimental settings.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Labs with live toggle proof
recommendation.body: Accept Labs as the experimental-settings seam, contingent on redacted evidence that both Code Mode transitions persist safely through the live Control UI and Gateway.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored both the proposed Labs implementation and the linked program that names Labs as the experimental-toggle surface.
